title: Request/Response body size caps are enforced at two points (Content-Length header + actual bytes)
description: fetch_session, call, and blob methods check Content-Length for an early exit, then also check actual bytes read. The comment 'Content-Length can lie' explains why the second check is not redundant. A future contributor might remove the second check as 'already checked via Content-Length'. Both checks are necessary: Content-Length can be forged or absent; bytes() can return more data than the header claimed. The two-check pattern should be preserved.
